attempted_claim: Prove or disprove that every self-adjoint generating tuple of L(F_2) whose joint law lies within the quantitative Guionnet-Shlyakhtenko-Hartglass-Nelson free-transport neighbourhood of the standard free semicircular law, in particular the canonical Hartglass-Nelson finite connected weighted-graph operator-valued semicircular models conditioned to be isomorphic to L(F_2), retains strictly positive Hayes 1-bounded entropy h >= c > 0 uniformly over the neighbourhood, so that the Jung-Hayes microstate obstruction ruling out Cartan subalgebras persists stably under free transport; this is consistent with the known Jung-Hayes theorem that L(F_2) is not strongly 1-bounded; the bounded one-hour attack applies the quantitative free-transport map estimates to explicit neighbourhood polynomials together with Hayes microstate covering-number bounds; a complete answer either proves the uniform positivity bound or exhibits an explicit in-neighbourhood tuple with entropy collapse h <= 0, a new degeneration witness for free transport.
decisive_failure: correctness: TARGET route proof fails. Lemma 1 has F/G reversed: Y=F(S), S=G(Y), so Y-microstates push via G not F; Omega defined via F is wrong side and degree bookkeeping uses D_F where D_G needed. Lemma 2 claims K(Omega)>=K(S-locus) from Omega subset S-locus, reversing inclusion: subset gives <=, not >=; surjectivity of G onto S-microstates (needing F direction) is never proved. Exact inverses would need global polynomial inverse Lipschitz both ways, but imported GSHN/Hartglass-Nelson transport is analytic power-series, not uniform polynomials D=6, L'=1.1. Seed V*=12 at eps*=0.01 is asserted without Hayes locus computation; h(S)=oo does not certify that instance. R-ball containment and quantifier order unproved. Conditioning graph models to L(F2) invokes open L(F_t) vs L(F2) problem, leaving in-particular scope vacuous. Script verifies only conditional arithmetic. originality: Headline conditioned to generate a factor isomorphic to L(F2) is substantively implied by stronger priors, hence recomputation not new result. Hayes (1505.06682/IMRN 2018) gives h(free semicircular n-tuple)=+infinity and Cartan/strongly 1-bounded => h<=0; Jung (math/0510576) gives strong 1-boundedness / free entropy dimension bound is isomorphism invariant (Brannan-Vergnioux cite). Together every generating tuple of any algebra isomorphic to L(F2) already has infinite/positive h and no Cartan, uniformly with no neighbourhood or polynomial estimate. Fused 3-query search found these exact priors; no new boundary, classification, or parameter is introduced. Transport lemmas at best re-derive invariance on N with invented constants. Prior need not state headline verbatim to cover it. value: No independent retrieval value under STANDARD. Given conditioning to L(F2), absence of Cartan follows trivially from Voiculescu/Jung-Hayes no-Cartan for L(F2) plus isomorphism invariance, not a new stability estimate; uniform h>=c=1.0 is same corollary with manufactured constant (V*=12, L'=1.1, D=6 rounded to 1.0) on an unnatural neighbourhood defined by representative uniform data with no literature position. Hartglass-Nelson in-particular scope is vacuous given open interpolated-factor classification. This is textbook restatement plus arbitrary finite slice and certification (script arithmetic) which does not create value, with no new question, boundary, benchmark, or downstream use beyond Hayes-Jung for all L(F2) generators.
